ACCESSION NUMBER: syn-announce-0001
The parties entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger. The board recommends that stockholders approve the merger. Closing is subject to regulatory approval and antitrust clearance under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Act. The company is confident the transaction will receive necessary regulatory approval. Expected to close in 2023.

ACCESSION NUMBER: syn-update-0002
The Agreement and Plan of Merger remains in effect. The board recommends that stockholders approve the merger. The parties received a second request from antitrust authorities. Timing is uncertain and there is no assurance the transaction will close.

ACCESSION NUMBER: syn-terminate-0003
The parties mutually agreed to terminate the merger agreement because there is no clear path to receive necessary regulatory approvals. Uncertainty as to when approvals could be obtained led to termination.

ACCESSION NUMBER: syn-hb-announce-0001
The company entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger. The board recommends the merger. Closing is subject to regulatory approval. Financing is not a condition to closing.

ACCESSION NUMBER: syn-hb-switch-0002
The company and counterparty mutually agreed to terminate the merger agreement. The board recommends that stockholders support a superior proposal with a new counterparty. A complaint was filed regarding the prior process.
